preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of nodes k to inspect must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each time spent on building a ball must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The number of edges must be n-1, and each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum grade Jacob can achieve, which is the minimum time spent among the first k nodes in the best DFS traversal.
